LESSON: WEAVING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three
Subject: CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Creating and Executing
Topic 1.7: Weaving
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Weaving, part of Creating and Executing in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three CREATIVE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can one create a plain weave paper in two colours?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Weaving together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Creativity and imagination: as the learner design aesthetically pleasing plain paper weave.

 Learning to learn: as the learner acquires new skills of interlacing to make a woven item.

19

Values:
 Responsibility: is enhanced as the learner disposes off paper cuttings after weaving.

 Social justice: is promoted as the learner shares tools with peers as they weave.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
 Cultural Appreciation: is fostered as the learners appreciate weaving as a traditional craft.

Link to other learning areas:

Environmental activities: as the learner disposes of waste to maintain the environment.
